# Linen theme
A warm neutral theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. It warms the surfaces, rounds the corners one
step further, and prefers sharper default fonts — in both light and dark appearance.
DSH Web 界面的暖中性主题：表面更温暖、圆角再圆一档、默认字体更锐利，亮色与暗色外观同时生效。
完整中文说明见下方 中文.
## Screenshots

softer corner scale:

## What it changes
| Area | Effect |
| Surfaces | Page, raised layers, overlay, sidebar, code blocks, and scrollbars move to a warm neutr

al palette |
| Borders and text | Four border steps and seven text steps retuned to the same warm ra

mp |
| Corner radius | A slider interpolates every tier between the product scale `4/8/12/16/20/28`
and the roundest `12/20/26/34/40/52`; 100 on the slider equals the rounded scale earlier releases sh

ipped |
| Fonts | Default text and code stacks prefer `system-ui` / `Cascadia Code`; emphasis drops

from 600 to 500 |
| Interactive fills | Hover, active, ghost-button, and floating-button fills follo
| Interactive fills | Hover, active, ghost-button, and floating-button fills follow the warm ramp |
## What it deliberately does not change
Each of these is blocked by the Host mechanism, not by taste:
- **Font sizes and line heights** — the theme presenter rewrites them from Settings on every apply,
so an override would leave the font-size stepper in Settings doing nothing. Use Appearance → font si

ze instead.
- **Elevation and shadow tokens** — declared on `body, body *`, so a body-level override

never reaches the elements that consume them.
- **Menu material** — `--dsw-menu-surface-fill` and `

--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter` are theme-owned; overriding them breaks the shared menu blur contract.
-
**Product icons** — `ThemeDefinition.icons` exists only on `ctx.theme.register`, which would replac

e your light/dark preference.
- **Brand, link, and state colors** — a theme that recolors success, w
arning, error, or link stops communicating state.
Circles, capsules, and hairline details keep their own literal geometry; only the shared `--dsw-radi
us-*` scale follows the theme.

The bundle is self-contained: no dependencies are installed at activation time (the schema library i
s vendored). Install it through the plugin manager with the absolute path to this directory:

Or from a packed tarball, extract it first and point `install_bundle` at the extracted directory.
Reload the window once after installing. The theme then applies immediately on every later load.
### Update
`install_bundle` refuses an already-installed package. Remove and reinstall:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replacing an installed package requires restarting `dsh` so the browser loads the new module generat
acing an installed package requires restarting `dsh` so the browser loads the new module generation.
## Configure
Open **Settings → Linen theme**. Changes apply immediately and are stored in the Host settings docum
ent, so they survive a restart and follow you across browsers.
| Setting | Values | Meaning |

| Enable the Linen theme | on / off | Off restores every product default |
| Palette | Warm / Produc

t | Product keeps the original colors and applies only corners and fonts |
| Corner radius | slider,
0–200 | Interpolates every radius tier: 0 is the product scale, 100 is the roundest scale earlier r

eleases shipped, 200 is rounder still |
| Emphasis weight | slider, 300–700 | Weight of emphasized b

ody text in steps of 100; product default is 600 |
| Body font | font list | Empty uses the theme st

ack; a font chosen in Appearance still wins |
| Code font | font list | Code blocks, inline code, an
d code text outside the terminal |
Dragging a slider repaints immediately but writes to the Host only when the gesture ends, so a drag
costs one settings write instead of one per pixel. Font fields take comma-separated family names and
commit on blur or Enter.
## Requirements

- A DeepSeek Harness profile with the Web client (`dsh web` or the desktop app).
- The `theme`, `slo
ts`, `configForms`, and `locale` client services, which the standard Web composition provides.

## Releasing
Publishing is tag-driven and needs no configuration: no secrets, no local build step.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The `Release` workflow then validates the package, builds the tarball, and attaches it to the GitHub
Release, using the `GITHUB_TOKEN` GitHub provides automatically. Pushing a tag that already has a r
elease replaces the attached asset instead of failing.
Before tagging, the same checks run on every push and pull request, and locally:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`scripts/verify.mjs` guards the invariants that would otherwise break silently: the browser module i
d must equal the package name, the settings namespace must equal the patch row id, every `Config` fi
eld must be `.volatile()`, the vendored schema library must resolve from the packed files, and every
locale must carry a title and description.
## Notes for theme authors
- Every token value is a `{ light, dark }` pair. The theme service rejects a bare string on purpose:

a single value goes illegible when the color scheme flips.
- The layer is applied through `override
Tokens`, so the Appearance preference keeps working and the theme never appears as a fourth choice.
- Settings fields must be `.volatile()`. The settings directory only exposes a namespace when at lea
st one field is live, and a token change must apply without remounting the browser plugin.
